positiveScenario.narrative: A constructive scenario where current headwinds abate.  Central banks achieve soft landing with inflation moderating.  This supports risk assets and the client's growth-oriented holdings.

portfolioImpact.rationale: Broad risk-on environment lifts equity and credit positions; gold hedge moderates gains

negativeScenario.narrative: A stress scenario where current risks compound.  Persistent inflation forces further rate hikes, pressuring duration and growth assets.  Energy concentration amplifies portfolio volatility.

portfolioImpact.rationale: Energy concentration exposed to supply shock; long duration bonds pressured; growth equities de-rate

arguments: Portfolio has explicit geopolitical hedges (gold, macro fund)
Short duration bond allocation limits rate sensitivity
Quality bias in equity holdings provides downside resilience
Single-stock energy concentration (97% of PF-0002) creates source-of-wealth overlap
Rising rates pressure long-duration fixed income (US Treasury 2045)
Illiquid alternatives (private equity, real estate) limit rebalancing agility
supportingData: US Treasury 2.375% 2045 down ~38% from cost basis
Private equity/real estate = meaningful illiquid allocation
mitigations: Reduce energy single-stock concentration via staged diversification
Add inflation-linked bonds (SYN-FI-0212) for real yield protection
Pre-approve rebalancing triggers for mandate breaches
Increase liquid reserves to 15%+ for opportunistic deployment

Gold and macro fund provide partial hedge but may not fully offset energy shock
Short duration bonds protect income stability; long Treasury is the main duration risk
Client objectives (diversify from family business) directly conflict with current concentration
Recommend phased diversification of energy position before Q4 2026 property purchase
Pre-approve rebalancing bands to act decisively if Hormuz situation worsens
